defect: final release stage cannot assert reset while the clock is stopped
rationale: The required reset asserts even with clk stopped, but only the first stage has an asynchronous reset pin; local_n retains one until another edge.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: The second stage has no async reset, so the reset does not assert without a running clock, which contradicts the stated requirement.
